ENQ-001.title: AI-assisted comparison of data definitions
ENQ-001.summary: Proposed pilot to compare the treatment of one information concept across selected specifications.
ENQ-001.question: Can a transparent AI-assisted method help practitioners identify and assess differences in data definitions across a small, agreed set of specifications?
ENQ-001.scope: Select one information concept and two or three specifications that participants may lawfully process. Source selection, ownership and participation remain to be agreed.
ENQ-001.audience: Clinical, technical, data and other health and care practitioners with relevant experience.
